ios.desc:
Brickit is a smart brick scanner that helps you turn your loose bricks into new creations.

Have a box, pile, or any collection of bricks at home? Brickit scans your bricks, helps you organize them, and suggests things you can build with the parts you already have.

With Brickit 5.0, the app is faster, clearer, and more useful than ever — whether you want to build something new, manage your family brick collection, or find a specific piece in a pile.

WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH BRICKIT

SCAN YOUR BRICKS

Spread out your bricks, take a photo with Brickit scanner, and let it recognize individual parts on the image.

BUILD FROM WHAT YOU HAVE

Brickit suggests thousands of ideas for the builds you can create with the bricks you already own. Build animals, robots, vehicles, spaceships, your favorite characters or anything you want.

FOLLOW STEP-BY-STEP INSTRUCTIONS

Use simple building instructions to create something new. Follow the steps exactly or use them as inspiration for your own ideas.

FIND BRICKS FASTER

Looking for a specific part? Select it in the catalog, and Brickit will highlight where it is in your photo. When building, the app also highlights the pieces you need for each step.

ORGANIZE YOUR COLLECTION

Keep track of your bricks digitally and make better use of the pieces you already own.

PERFECT FOR LEGO® FANS, FAMILIES, AND BUILDERS

Brickit is made for anyone with loose toy bricks at home — kids, parents, collectors, and adult builders who want to rediscover their collection and build more from it.

BRICKIT PRO SUBSCRIPTION

Brickit Pro gives you access to advanced features and more ways to scan, build, and organize your bricks.

— Brickit Pro subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.

— Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account upon confirmation of purchase.

— Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period.

— You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal in your Account Settings after purchase.

— Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

— License agreement: https://brickit.app/eula/

— Privacy policy: https://brickit.app/privacy-policy/

Brickit was created by fans and is not an official LEGO® product. The LEGO Group does not sponsor, authorize, or support Brickit.
